context: Checks the end-to-end four-stage workflow: method fallback, documentation before code, staged references, own tokens and visual verification.

checklist.name: Tries the automated method first
checklist.description: Checks whether browser automation is available before choosing a method

checklist.name: Falls back to source inspection
checklist.description: Uses curl source inspection when automation is unavailable and says so

checklist.name: Documents before coding
checklist.description: Writes the five theme documents before editing any source file

checklist.name: Loads references per stage
checklist.description: Loads `references/extraction.md` for extraction only, not all three up front

checklist.name: Loads the right later references
checklist.description: Uses `references/tailwind-mapping.md` for documenting and applying and `references/verification.md` only for verification

checklist.name: Does not copy stylesheets
checklist.description: Does not copy the source site's CSS files into the project

checklist.name: Rebuilds values as tokens
checklist.description: Rebuilds extracted values as the project's own tokens

checklist.name: Starts the dev server
checklist.description: Starts the local server before verification

checklist.name: Performs a visual diff
checklist.description: Compares the reference site with the local build visually

checklist.name: Does not declare done early
checklist.description: Reports completion only after the diff result is recorded under the artifacts directory
